objective: Prospectively test the already-qualified mutable-closure observer, deterministic repair constructor, and equivalence-class selector on a new source-distinct training/future pair without tuning after source or outcomes.

method_authority.rule: Method implementation files must remain byte-identical to qualified_commit throughout this prospective experiment.

metadata_query.projection: Search transport may internally include PR body, but orchestration MUST forward only issue_number,title,url to the research model. PR body, diff, patches, comments and source bytes are not emitted or used.
metadata_query.inspect: For titles beginning fix case-insensitive, call get_pr_info only inside orchestration and forward only merged/base_sha/head_sha/changed_files_count; call list_pr_changed_filenames and forward only filenames. No body/diff/patch/comments.
qualifier: changed file count is between 2 and 4 inclusive
exactly one changed .py path is production-like: not under tests/, test/, docs/, examples/, scripts/, benchmarks/, benchmark/, and basename does not start test_
at least one changed .py path is author-test-like: under tests/ or test/ or basename starts test_
no changed path is pyproject.toml, setup.py, setup.cfg, tox.ini, requirements*, poetry.lock, uv.lock, pdm.lock, Pipfile*, or .github workflow
metadata_query.per_repo_rule: At most the first metadata-qualified PR in provider order from each repository may enter the candidate list.
metadata_query.role_rule: First two qualified repositories in declared repository order become TRAINING and SEALED_FUTURE.
metadata_query.no_replacement: After ROLE_MANIFEST_V2 is committed, later source/environment/native failure does not select a replacement.

supplement_order: PEP 735 dependency group named test if declared
project extra named test if declared
project extra named tests if declared
project extra named dev if declared
environment_policy.fixed_test_command: python -m pytest -q <derived changed test nodes or files>
environment_policy.refusal: If base editable install plus first applicable declared test supplement cannot run the exact changed author tests, environment admission is UNKNOWN and role is not replaced.

test_derivation.after_role_freeze: Read TRAINING base and exact head author-test blob(s) only. Never read repaired head production.
test_derivation.changed_tests: AST-parse base and head author test files; select top-level Test* classes/functions whose source spans differ or are new, then use their pytest node IDs. If mechanical derivation is empty or ambiguous, admission UNKNOWN.
test_derivation.protected_original: Overlay exact author-test head blob(s) onto original base production and require nonempty executed failing assertions with zero collection/environment errors.

prospective_science.training: Run immutable method authority unchanged. No new source predicate, repair form, AST coordinate heuristic, selection criterion or candidate after source reveal.
prospective_science.future: Only after training warrants acquired capability with withdrawal/restoration may SEALED_FUTURE source/test bodies be opened.
prospective_science.promotion: Future must show authentic original failure and a method-caused protected improvement under unchanged method; full G2 additionally requires physical removal/restoration and independent future native qualification.
prospective_science.baselines: If future reaches positive gate, execute equally informed executable-ledger and available strong-agent comparison with acquisition/check/restart costs; absence keeps comparative claim UNKNOWN.
prospective_science.fail_closed: No observation, no repair, environment ambiguity, zero-test green, skip/error, source mismatch or future non-improvement remains exact UNKNOWN/REJECTED boundary.

prior_existing_sealed_future: alexmojaki/executing#50 remains unopened and excluded from V2.
